Photoelectric Effect & Quantum Theory:
Explain three experimental observations of the photoelectric effect that wave theory fails to explain, and how Einstein's photon model resolves each. [6 marks]
a:
1. Threshold frequency f₀: Waves predict any frequency should emit electrons eventually; photon energy E = hf requires hf ≥ Φ [2].
2. Instantaneous emission at even tiny intensity: Wave energy spreads slowly; single photon transfers all energy E = hf instantly to one electron [2].
3. KE_max depends on frequency, independent of intensity: Intensity only controls photon arrival rate (photocurrent), whereas excess photon energy hf - Φ sets KE_max [2].

Compare X-ray Computed Tomography (CT scanning) and Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) in terms of physical mechanism, soft-tissue contrast, and radiation risk. [6 marks]
a: Mechanism: CT rotates thin X-ray fan beams around patient reconstructing 3D slice attenuation maps; MRI aligns hydrogen-1 proton spins in a strong magnetic field using RF pulses and detects Larmor relaxation signals [2]. Soft-tissue contrast: MRI excels for brain/ligaments/soft tissue; CT excels for bone/lungs/fast trauma [2]. Risk: CT uses ionising radiation; MRI uses non-ionising fields (safe for repeated scans unless patient has metallic implants) [2].

1st Law: Sum of currents entering any junction equals sum leaving (ΣI_in = ΣI_out) — Conservation of electric charge [2].
2nd Law: Around any closed circuit loop, algebraic sum of EMFs equals sum of potential drops (ΣE = ΣIR) — Conservation of energy [2].

Distinguish between diffraction and interference of waves, and explain why coherent light sources (e.g., laser split into two slits) are needed to observe stationary two-source interference fringes. [5 marks]
a: Diffraction is the spreading of waves passing through an aperture or around an obstacle; interference is the superposition of overlapping waves forming regions of constructive and destructive amplitude [2]. Coherent sources have identical frequency and a constant phase difference so bright/dark fringe positions remain fixed rather than washing out rapidly [3].

(b) Electric field strength equals the negative potential gradient [1].

(b) Those ions then enter another magnetic field B₂ = 0.40 T and trace a semicircle of radius 0.26 m. Calculate the charge-to-mass ratio q/m of the ions. [3 marks]
a:
(a) Electric force balances magnetic force: qE = Bqv -> v = E/B = (4.0×10⁴)/0.080 = 5.0 × 10⁵ m/s [3].
(b) B₂qv = mv²/r -> q/m = v/(B₂r) = (5.0×10⁵)/(0.40 × 0.26) = 4.81 × 10⁶ C/kg [3].

Deformation of Materials:

Ductile metals show linear elastic region then clear plastic necking; brittle materials (glass/cast iron) fracture cleanly straight after linear elastic limit; polymers (rubber) show huge nonlinear elastic hysteresis loops [3].

(a) FM offers higher audio quality and noise immunity (wider bandwidth) over shorter line-of-sight range; AM travels further via skywave reflection at lower bandwidth but suffers electrical interference [3].
(b) Attenuation arises from light absorption/scattering by glass impurities and multipath dispersion; repeaters regenerate clean square digital pulses along long cables [3].

Record two steady temperatures θ₁, θ₂ at separation Δx along bar of cross-sectional area A [1]. Lagging prevents radial heat loss so axial flow is uniform: P = kA(θ₁ - θ₂)/Δx -> k calculated [2].

q: Prove by Mathematical Induction that ∑_{r=1}^n r(r + 1) = n(n + 1)(n + 2) / 3 for all positive integers n. [5 marks]

Base case n=1: LHS = 1(2) = 2; RHS = 1(2)(3)/3 = 2 (holds) [1].
Inductive step: Assume true for n = k. For k + 1: k(k+1)(k+2)/3 + (k+1)(k+2) = (k+1)(k+2)[k/3 + 1] = (k+1)(k+2)(k+3)/3 [3]. Holds for n=k+1 -> proven by induction [1].

a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [20 marks]
- **Nzwovera (Vowels):** /a, e, i, o, u/ — mweya unobuda wakasununguka pasina chivharo mukanwa; dzinogadzira izwi dzakazvimirira [6 marks].
- **Zvivharamukanwa (Consonants):** Mweya unombovharwa kana kumanikidzwa; **Bilabials (miromo miviri):** /p, b, bh, m, v/; **Nasals (mhino):** /m, n, ny, n'/ (sezviri muna *mama, nana, nyama, n'anga*) [14 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Nyora pasi mipanda yemazita (Noun Classes 1–10) yemuChiShona uchiita chivakashure (prefix) chechimwe nechimwe uye muenzaniso wezita muushoma nemuuwandu. [20 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [20 marks]
- **Mupanda 1/2 (mu-/va-):** munhu / vanhu [2]
- **Mupanda 1a/2a (Ø/va-):** baba / vababa [2]
- **Mupanda 3/4 (mu-/mi-):** muti / miti [2]
- **Mupanda 5/6 (ri-/ma-):** badza / mapadza [2]
- **Mupanda 7/8 (chi-/zvi-):** chigaro / zvigaro [2]
- **Mupanda 9/10 (N-/N-):** mombe / mombe [2]
- **Mupanda 11/10 (ru-/dzin-):** ruoko / maoko kana rwizi / nzizi [4]
- **Mupanda 12/13 (ka-/tu-), 14 (hu-), 15 (ku-), 16–18 (pa-, ku-, mu-):** kutaurwa zvakanaka [4]
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Ratidza mashandiro ezvivakazwi zvinoenderana nemudzi wechiito (**verb extensions**): *-ir-/-er-* (applied), *-is-/-es-* (causative), *-an-* (reciprocal), ne*-w-/-iw-* (passive) pachishandiswa mudzi wekuti **-bik-** kana **-tor-**. [20 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [20 marks]
- **Applied (-ir-/-er-):** *bikira* / *torera* — kuita basa uchimirira mumwe munhu kana pachinhu chakati (e.g., *Amai vanobikira vaeni sadza*) [5 marks].
- **Causative (-is-/-es-):** *bikisa* / *toresa* — kukonzera kuti mumwe aite chiito [5 marks].
- **Reciprocal (-an-):** *bikirana* / *torana* — kuitirana basa pamwe chete [5 marks].
- **Passive (-w-/-iw-):** *bikwa* / *torwa* — chiito chinoitwa pamusoro pechinhu (*Sadza rakabikwa naTinashe*) [5 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Tsanangura basa rinoshandwa ne**zvisazitasingwi (pronouns)** ne**zvipauro (qualificatives)** mukugadzira mutsara wakanaka weChiShona, uchipa mienzaniso mitatu yeimwe neimwe. [15 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [15 marks]
- **Zvisazitasingwi (Demonstratives, Possessives, Absolute pronouns):** *iye, uyu, vaye, wangu* — zvinomirira kana kunongedza zita risina kududzwa patsva [7 marks].
- **Zvipauro (Adjectives, Enumeratives, Relatives):** *murefu, vaviri, vanoshanda* — zvinotsanangura chimiro, huwandu kana maitiro ezita muwirirano yemupanda [8 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Ipai mutsauko uripo pakati pe**zviito zvinoratidza nguva dzakasiyana (tenses)** uye **kushanduka kweizwi (tone — High/Low)** mumazwi maviri akanyorwa zvakafanana sa**guru** (big vs tripe/cave) uye **kurova** (hit vs disappear). [15 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [15 marks]
- **Kukwirira nekudzikira kweizwi (Tonology):** MuChiShona mutauro une izwi (tonal language): *gúrù* (H-L = huru/big) vs *gùrù* (L-L = bwiro/den kana guru remombe); *kúròvà* vs *kùróvà* (kushaikwa / kurova munhu) [9 marks].
- **Nguva dzechiito:** *Ndakabika* (kare), *Ndiri kubika* (izvozvi), *Ndichabika* (mangwana), *Ndinozobika* [6 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Nyora **pfupiso (summary)** isingapfuure mazwi 100 inotsanangura matambudziko anotarisana nevechidiki mumaguta ekupedzisira, uchishandisa mutauro wakanaka weChiShona chisina kusanganiswa neChirungu. [20 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [20 marks]
- **Pfungwa Huru [12 marks]:** Kushaya mabasa, kushandisa zvinodhaka, kukwira kwerendi, kutsvaga dzidzo yepamusoro, uye kusvika kwehupenyu hwemadhorobha hunoda mari zuva nezuva.
- **Mutauro & Kutevedzera Mazwi [8 marks]:** Zvirevo zvipfupi zvakajeka, chisina "ChiRungu chemunzira", kuverenga mazwi ari pasi pe100.
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Ongorora mashandisirwo emitemo ye**Standard Shona Orthography (Zvimiso neKunyora Kwakarurama)** mumitsara inotevera uchigadzirisa zvikanganiso: (a) "Ndino enda kuchikoro mangwana." (b) "Mwana wa amai vangu auya." (c) "Vana ve chikoro vari kutamba bhora mu munda." (d) "Ndinoda kudya sa dza." [12 marks]
a:
### Kugadzirisa [12 marks]
- **(a)** *Ndinoenda kuchikoro mangwana.* (Conjunctive writing — chibatanidzwa chechiito chinosungirirwa) [3 marks].
- **(b)** *Mwana waamai vangu auya.* (Kureba kwenyora kana kunyora zvimwe chete pasina kupatsanura chitaridzi chebato) [3 marks].
- **(c)** *Vana vechikoro vari kutamba bhora mumunda.* (Zvibatanidzwa zvechivakashure *ve-* na*mu-* zvinonyorwa pamwe chete nezita) [3 marks].
- **(d)** *Ndinoda kudya sadza.* (Zita rimwe chete) [3 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Tsanangura mutsauko uripo pakati pe**dzitsi rezita (noun stem)**, **chivakashure (noun prefix)**, ne**chigumisiro (terminative)** mumazwi anoti *mukomana, chikoro, zvibage, vatema*. [16 marks]
a:
### Kupatsanura Mazwi (Morphological Analysis) [16 marks]
- *mukomana:* `mu-` (prefix cl.1) + `-koman-` (stem) + `-a` [4]
- *chikoro:* `chi-` (prefix cl.7) + `-koro` (loan stem from English/Afrikaans) [4]
- *zvibage:* `zvi-` (prefix cl.8) + `-bage` (stem) [4]
- *vatema:* `va-` (prefix cl.2) + `-tem-` (stem) + `-a` [4]
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Tsanangura kushandiswa kwe**nyaudzosingwi (ideophones)** nemaitiro adzo pakusimudzira chimiro chemutauro mumabuku ekunyora nhetembo kana nyaya pfupi. [15 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [15 marks]
- **Tsananguro:** Nyaudzosingwi mazwi anoburitsa chiitiko, ruzha, ruvara kana kunzwa zvakazara panguva imwe (e.g., *kwii, tsvaa, zii, bha, tande*) [5 marks].
- **Basa reMutauro:** Dzinoisa mufananidzo wakajeka mupfungwa dzemuvengi (*vivid imagery*), dzinomhanyisa mutinhimira wenyaya, uye dzinosimbisa manzwiro emutambi [10 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Rongedza tsumo shanu (5) dzeChiShona dzine chekuita ne**kushanda nesimba nekushingirira**, uchitsanangura zvinoreva imwe neimwe mukurera vechidiki. [15 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [15 marks]
1. *Badza guru kupa murimi* / *Chara chimwe hachitswanyi inda* (kubatana pabasa)
2. *Chitsva chiri murutsoka* (kubuda kushanda kunounza kubudirira)
3. *Kugara nhaka huona dzevamwe* (kudzidza kubva kune vakamboshanda)
4. *Mbudzi kudya mufenje hufananyina* (kutevedzera kushanda kwevabereki)
5. *Shungu dzinokunda simba* / *Chakafukidza dzimba matenga* — makisi matatu patsumo imwe neimwe (1 = tsumo chaiyo, 2 = tsananguro yakadzama) [15 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Nyora **rondedzero yekupikisa kana kutsigira (Argumentative Essay)** pamusoro pechirevo chinoti: *"Kudzidza mitauro yechinyakare saChiShona kumayunivhesiti kunobatsira budiriro yenyika pane kudzidza masvomhu nesainzi chete."* [30 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [30 marks]
- **Kurongeka (Introduction, Body Paragraphs, Balanced Counter-argument, Conclusion) [10 marks]**
- **Pfungwa [12 marks]:** Koshesa kuchengetedza tsika, kuturikira mutemo nemishonga kuvanhu vekumaruwa, midzi yeUnhu, nekurangarira masvomhu/tekinoroji sezvinoenderana zvose pamwe chete.
- **Unyanzvi hweMutauro [8 marks]:** Kushandisa tsumo, madimikira, zvirahwe zvinokodzera, uye zvimiso zvakakwana.
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Cherechedza **kuyambuka kwemazwi kubva mune mimwe mitauro (Borrowing & Loanword Adaptation)** sa*bhasikoro, chikoro, dhorobha, terevhizheni*, uchitsanangura mitemo yehuShona (phonological nativisation) inotevedzerwa. [15 marks]
a:
### Mitemo yeKunyorwa kweMazwi Akakweretwa [15 marks]
1. **Kuvhura chivharamukanwa nenzozvera (Open syllables CV):** Hapana shoko reChiShona rinoperera neconsonant (*school → chi-ko-ro*, *town/dorp → dho-ro-bha*) [6 marks].
2. **Kupatsanura zvibatanidzwa zvakaoma (Cluster breaking):** *bicycle → bha-si-ko-ro* [5 marks].
3. **Kupinza mumipanda yemazita (Noun-class assignment):** *chi-koro* muClass 7, *ma-bhuku* muClass 6 [4 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Tsanangura **mitauro yehuShona (Shona Dialects — Zezuru, Karanga, Manyika, Korekore, Ndau)**, uchiratidza zvinhu zviviri zvinoita kuti Standard Shona ive mutauro unobatanidza vanhu vose. [15 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [15 marks]
- **Mapoka Makuru:** Zezuru (pakati), Karanga (kuchamhembe/Masvingo), Manyika (kumabvazuva/Manicaland), Korekore (kumaodzanyemba), Ndau (Chipinge/Chimanimani) — mutsauko uri pamazwi nemataurirwo maduku (e.g., *sadza / chima / ibvu*) [9 marks].
- **Kubatanidzwa naDoke (1931):** Mitemo yegrama yakafanana (mipanda yemazita, zviito) inobvumira kunzwisisana kwevose mubhuku nepanhepfenyuro [6 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Shandura ndima yeChirungu inotevera uchiiisa muChiShona chakanaka (Translation): *"Sustainable agriculture requires farmers to protect topsoil, plant drought-tolerant small grains, and share rainwater harvesting knowledge across generations."* [15 marks]
a:
### Kuturikira Kwakarurama [15 marks]
- *"Kurima kunogara kuchienderera mberi kunoda kuti varimi vachengetedze ivhu repamusoro, vadyare zviyo zviduku zvinotsungirira zuva nezvakaoma zvakaita semapfunde nemhunga, uye vapangane ruzivo rwekutamba nekuchengetedza mvura yemudenga kubva kune chimwe chizvarwa kuenda kune chimwe."* (Makisi anopiwa pakutaurwa kwechokwadi pasina kutadza zvinoreva Chirungu) [15 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Tsanangura zvinoreva **madimikira (idioms)** mashanu aya: (a) *Kuita meso meso* (b) *Kurova bembera* (c) *Kudya marasha* (d) *Kubata hana* (e) *Kusungira dzinza*. [15 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [15 marks]
- **(a) Kuita meso meso:** Kutsvaga zvinhu zvakawanda kana kusavimbika murudo [3].
- **(b) Kurova bembera:** Kutaura nyaya uchireva mumwe munhu aripo pasina kudoma zita rake [3].
- **(c) Kudya marasha:** Kutambura zvikuru kana kupindwa nekushaya kukuru / hasha dzakanyanya [3].
- **(d) Kubata hana:** Kuvhunduka kana kunzwa kutya kukuru [3].
- **(e) Kusungira dzinza:** Kutora matanho ekuchengetedza hukama kana mbiri yemhuri/rudzi [3].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Ongorora mashandiro e**chirevo chakareba (Complex Sentence)** muChiShona uchiratidza mutsauko uripo pakati pechirevo chikuru (main clause) nechirevo chinotevera (subordinate clause). [15 marks]
a:
### Kupatsanura Zvirevo (Syntax) [15 marks]
- **Muenzaniso:** *"Kana mvura ikanaya zvakanaka, varimi vekumaruwa vachakohwa zviyo zvakawanda."* [5 marks]
- **Chirevo chinotevera (Subordinate clause):** *Kana mvura ikanaya zvakanaka* — hachikwanise kumira choga sechirevo chakazara.
- **Chirevo chikuru (Main clause):** *varimi vekumaruwa vachakohwa zviyo zvakawanda* — chinopa pfungwa huru yakazara [10 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Nyora **tsamba yepamutemo (Formal Letter)** kuna Sachigaro weKanzuru yedhorobha rako uchikumbira kuti pave nemabini akawanda uye mvura yakachena munharaunda yenyu. [25 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Chimiro cheTsamba yePamutemo:** Kero mbiri, zuva, *Wadiwa Changamire / Mai*, musoro wenyaya wakasimba (*CHIKUMBISO CHEKUGADZIRISWA KWETSANANGURO YEMVURA NEMABINI*), mhedziso (*Wenyu akatendeka* + siginicha nezita) [8 marks].
- **Zvirimo & Mutauro:** Zvikonzero zveutano (kudzivirira cholera/typhoid), mutauro weruremekedzo usinganyombi [17 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Tsanangura **kusanganiswa kwemazita ezviito (Compound Nouns & Nominalisation)** muChiShona uchipa mienzaniso mipfumbamwe kubva pazviito zvakasiyana. [15 marks]
a:
### Kugadzirwa kwemazita kubva kuZviito [15 marks]
- *ku- + rima → murimi* (agent noun cl.1); *mubiki, mudzidzisi, mutungamiriri* [6 marks].
- *Zita remubatanidzwa (Compound nouns):* *muchekacheka, chigaramapfeni, mudyandigere, mufushwa-nyemba* — kuratidza mashandiro emipanda nezvivakazwi pakuumba mazita matsva [9 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Tsanangura **basa reZviverengero neZvishandiso zveNguva (Temporal & Aspectual Markers)** sa*-ri*, *-cha-*, *-aka-*, *-nga-* muChiShona, uchipa mutsara mumwe pamutambo woga woga. [16 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [16 marks]
- **`-ri` (Progressive):** *Tiri kudzidza ChiShona* — chiito chiri kuitika panguva iyoyo [4].
- **`-cha-` (Future/Persistive):** *Ndichaenda kuBulawayo* / *Acharova basa* [4].
- **`-aka-` (Remote Past):** *Vakaenda kumusha gore rapera* [4].
- **`-nga-` (Conditional/Potential):** *Ungaita basa iri kana ukashanda nesimba* [4].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Tsanangura mutsauko uripo pakati pe**zviito zvinoda chinhu (Transitive verbs)** ne**zviito zvisingade chinhu (Intransitive verbs)**, uchipa mienzaniso mitatu yeimwe neimwe. [15 marks]
a:
### Transitive vs Intransitive Verbs [15 marks]
- **Transitive (zvinotambira chinobatwa / object):** *-tem-* (*Mwana akatema muti*), *-vereng-* (*Tafadzwa anoverenga bhuku*), *-bik-* [7 marks].
- **Intransitive (zvinogona kumira zvoga pasina object):** *-far-* (*Sekuru vakafara*), *-mhany-* (*Imbwa yakamhanya*), *-rar-* (*Mwana akarara*) [8 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Ongorora mashandisirwo e**chivakazwi chekuzvidavirira (Reflexive prefix *-zvi-*)** ne**zvivakashure zvekudzokorora (Reduplication)** sa*famba-famba*, *taura-taura* mumutauro weChiShona. [15 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [15 marks]
- **`-zvi-` (Reflexive):** Munhu anozviitira chiito iye pachake (*Akazvikuvadza pabasa*; *Tinofanira kuzvibata zvakanaka*) [7 marks].
- **Reduplication (Kudzokorora mudzi):** Kunoratidza kuita chinhu zvishoma nezvishoma, kakawanda, kana pasina chinangwa chakadzama (*kufamba-famba, kunwa-nwa, kubata-bata*) [8 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Nyora **hurukuro (Dialogue)** pakati pemudzimai mukuru nemuzukuru wake vachikurukura nezve**kukosha kwechikafu chechinyakare (zviyo, nyimo, derere, mutakura)** pakurwisa zvirwere zvemazuva ano. [25 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Chimiro cheHurukuro:** Mazita evatauri kuruboshwe nekoroni (*Ambuya:* / *Rudo:*), mhinduro dzinopindirana zvine ruremekedzo netsika yeUnhu [7 marks].
- **Zvirimo:** Kudzivirira shuga, BP, kushaya simba; kuchengeta mhodzi dzechinyakare; kushandisa zvirungamutauro zvinonwisa mvura [18 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Tsanangura **nzira dzekurairidza netsika dzeUnhu** dzinowanikwa mune zvemitauro ye**zvirahwe (riddles)** ne**mitupo/zvidao (totems & praise poetry)** dzevaShona. [20 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [20 marks]
- **Zvirahwe:** Zvinokudza kufunga kwakadzama, kuyeuka zvisikwa, uye kugara pamwe chete semhuri pameso pemoto manheru [10 marks].
- **Mitupo neZvidao:** Zvinoomesa hukama hweropa (kudzivira kuroorana kwehama), zvinochengetedza mhuka/nhengo dzesango (conservation taboos), uye zvinopa chiremerera pavanhu (*Maita Shava*, *Maita Mhofu*) [10 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Ongorora dambudziko re**kusanganiswa kwemitauro (Code-switching / "Shonglish")** pakati pevechidiki nhasi uye tsanangura nzira ina dzekuchengetedza nekukudza ChiShona chakanaka muzvikoro nemumagazini. [20 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [20 marks]
- **Zvikonzero zveShonglish:** Tekinoroji, midhiya, kurerukirwa mukutaura kwemumadhorobha, nekushaya mazwi matsva ezvekombiyuta mumaruwa [8 marks].
- **Nzira dzeKukudza ChiShona:** Kugadzira duramazwi retekinoroji reChiShona, makwikwi ekunyora mabhuku/nhetembo, kudzidzisa zvidzidzo zvevanhu vose muChiShona, uye kushandisa ChiShona chitsvene panhepfenyuro [12 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: Tsanangura zvinoreva **nhepfenyuro yekufananidza (Simile — *kufanana na-* / *se-*)** ne**enenzaniso chaiyo (Metaphor)** uchipa mienzaniso mina yega yega mukurumbidza munhu kana kunyora rondedzero. [15 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [15 marks]
- **Simile (Enzaniso):** Inoshandisa *se-, sa-, kunge* (*Anomhanya seshumba*; *Anopenya kunge zuva*) [7 marks].
- **Metaphor (Dimikira reufananidzi):** Inodoma chinhu chacho zvakananga kuti chive chimwe (*Baba ndimambo mumba*; *Vana ava ishumba pabasa*) — inopa simba rakadzama kupfuura simile [8 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 1 — Language and Literature

q: **Kuongorora Nhetembo (Practical Criticism):** *"Mwana wangu, nzira yekuguta haina mugwagwa wakafaranuka / Inopfuura nepahura hwemingwa nezvidhinha zvedikita."* Ongorora kushandiswa kwemufananidzo (imagery), mutinhimira (rhythm), uye dingindira (theme) mundima iyi. [25 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Mifananidzo:** *"pahura hwemingwa"* ne*"zvidhinha zvedikita"* zvinobatanidza kurwadziwa kwemuviri nekushanda nesimba senzira yeruponeso nekuguta [12 marks].
- **Dingindira & Mutinhimira:** Kuraira vechidiki kuti pasina kutamburira budiriro hapana chouviri; kurongwa kwezviperengo (alliteration *m-*, *zv-*) kunosimbisa kudzika kwezano remubereki [13 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 2 — Literature and Analysis

q: Mordikai Hamutyinei — *Kusasana Kunoparira*: Ongorora kuti munyori anoshandisa sei matambudziko emhuri nenyaya dzerudo mukuyambira vanhu pamusoro pehudzvanyiriri hwezvemari nemaitiro asina tsika. [25 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Zvirimo:** Kuratidza mugumo unopwanya wekupfumbata mari zvisiri pamutemo kana kutevera mafaro emadhorobha tichikanganwa mhuri [15 marks].
- **Unyanzvi:** Kushandisa tsumo dzakadzama, zita rebhuku pacharo, uye kukwikwidzana kwevatambi (characters) kudzidzisa kugutsikana neUnhu [10 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 2 — Literature and Analysis

q: T.K. Tsodzo — *Pafunge*: Ongorora dambudziko re**kuroorana uye kusaenzana kwetsika neChikristu** sezvinoratidzwa muupenyu hwaRudo, Winnie, naMufundisi Lovedale. [25 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Kukwikwidzana kweTsika:** Winnie anoramba kusungwa netsika dzechinyakare asi achiguma ave munhu asina midzi; Mufundisi Lovedale anofumura unyengeri hwevafundisi vanoparidza rudo asi vachinyima vatema kodzero [15 marks].
- **Zita reBhuku ("Pafunge"):** Danho rekufunga patsva pamusoro pemhuri, dzidzo, nekusarura [10 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 2 — Literature and Analysis

q: Charles Mungoshi — *Kunyarara Hakusi Kutaura?*: Ongorora kushandiswa kwe**runyararo (silence)** ne**pfungwa dzemukati (interior monologue)** pakuburitsa kurwadziwa kwaLucia naEric. [25 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Basa reRunyararo:** Vanhu vanoratidza kuteerera kunze asi mukati vachifashukira nekusagutsikana, hasha, nekusuwa; Eric anodzokera kubva kunyika dzekunze asina mufaro chaiwo [15 marks].
- **Chimiro chitsva:** Mungoshi anoshandisa marongero epfungwa (stream of consciousness) anokwidziridza runyoro rweChiShona kusvika pachidanho chepamusoro [10 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 2 — Literature and Analysis

q: Charles Mungoshi — *Ndiko Kupindana Kwamazuva*: Tsanangura kuti munyori anoburitsa sei kupindana kwezvinhu muupenyu hwaRex naMagi, uye basa retsumo pakugadzirisa gakava remhuri. [25 marks]
a:
### Muganhu weMakisi [25 marks]
- **Shanduko yeUpenyu:** Rex anotadza kutonga shanduko yemubato wake nekukwezvwa nemadhorobha; Magi anomiririra kutsungirira kwevakadzi vanochengetedza musha [14 marks].
- **Unyanzvi:** Mutauro wakanyorova, kusanganisa kunzwisisa kwepfungwa dzemunhu nemashandisirwo enguva [11 marks].
p: Shona A-Level Paper 2 — Literature and Analysis

q:
Hypothesis Testing (Mean — Known Variance):
Bags of sugar are labelled 2.00 kg with σ = 0.06 kg. A random sample of 36 bags has mean x̄ = 1.975 kg. Test at the 5% significance level (two-tailed, critical z = ±1.96) whether the packing machine is miscalibrated. [5 marks]
a: H₀: μ = 2.00; H₁: μ ≠ 2.00 [1]. SE = 0.06/√36 = 0.01 [1]. z = (1.975 - 2.00)/0.01 = -2.50 [2]. Since |-2.50| > 1.96, reject H₀: significant evidence at 5% level that mean weight differs from 2.00 kg [1].
p: Statistics A-Level Paper 2 — Structured Questions

q:
Chi-Squared Test of Independence:
A 2×2 contingency table compares Study Method (Visual vs Audio) against Pass/Fail across 100 learners: Visual Pass 36, Visual Fail 14; Audio Pass 24, Audio Fail 26. Test for association at 5% significance (df = 1, χ²_crit = 3.841). [6 marks]
a: H₀: Study method and exam result are independent [1]. Row totals 50, 50; Col totals 60, 40 -> Expected: E_Pass = 30, E_Fail = 20 in both rows [2]. χ² = (6²/30)+(6²/20)+(6²/30)+(6²/20) = 1.2+1.8+1.2+1.8 = 6.00 [2]. Since 6.00 > 3.841, reject H₀: significant association exists [1].

q:
Goodness-of-Fit Chi-Squared (Poisson):
Accidents per week over 50 weeks were: 0 (20 weeks), 1 (18 weeks), 2 (9 weeks), ≥3 (3 weeks), total accidents = 46. Test fit to Po(0.92) at 5% level, explaining why last classes combine. [6 marks]
a: Expected freqs (50 × e^(-0.92) 0.92^k/k!): E(0)=19.93, E(1)=18.33, E(2)=8.43, E(≥3)=3.31 (last combined so E≥5 where needed; df = k - 1 - 1 = 2 since λ estimated) [3]. χ² ≈ 0.0002 + 0.006 + 0.038 + 0.029 = 0.073 << 5.991 -> do not reject H₀: Poisson fits well [3].

q:
Type I & Type II Errors:
Define Type I error, Type II error, and Power of a statistical test, illustrating with a hypothesis test of H₀: p = 0.10 against H₁: p > 0.10 for X ~ B(20, p) with rejection region X ≥ 5. [6 marks]
a: Type I (α): rejecting H₀ when true = P(X ≥ 5 | p=0.10) = 0.0432 [2]. Type II (β): failing to reject H₀ when H₁ is true (e.g., if true p=0.25, β = P(X ≤ 4 | p=0.25) = 0.4148) [2]. Power = 1 - β = 0.5852 (probability of correctly detecting genuine effect) [2].

Hypothesis Test for Binomial Proportion:

a: H₀: p = 0.80, H₁: p ≠ 0.80 [1]. Under B(20, 0.80), P(X ≤ 11) = 0.00998 < 0.025 (2.5% upper/lower tail) [3]. Reject H₀: strong evidence germination rate is below 80% [1].

q:
Hypothesis Test for Poisson Rate:
Road junction historically averages 4.0 accidents/month. After installing traffic lights, 1 accident occurs in the next month. Test at 5% level (one-tailed) whether lights reduced accidents. [4 marks]
a: H₀: λ = 4.0, H₁: λ < 4.0 [1]. P(X ≤ 1 | Po(4.0)) = e⁻⁴(1 + 4) = 5 × 0.0183 = 0.0916 [2]. Since 0.0916 > 0.05, do not reject H₀ (insufficient evidence yet at 5%) [1].

q:

q:
Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Non-Parametric Test:
Explain when to prefer the Wilcoxon signed-rank test over a paired t-test, and state the test statistic T calculation rule. [4 marks]
a: Use Wilcoxon when paired differences are heavily skewed, ordinal, or contain extreme outliers violating normality needed for small-sample t-tests [2]. Rank |d_i| (ignoring 0s), attach signs back, and take T = min(ΣR⁺, ΣR⁻) comparing against critical table [2].

q:

a: (a) x = 40 lies far outside observed data (extrapolation) where linear relationship may break down completely [2]. (b) Curved U/∩ patterns in residual (y - ŷ) plots expose non-linearity, while fanning spread reveals non-constant variance [2].

q:
Maximum Likelihood Estimation (Conceptual & Applied):
For a sample x₁,...,xₙ from Po(λ), derive the Maximum Likelihood Estimator (MLE) λ̂ by differentiating the log-likelihood function. [4 marks]
a: L(λ) = ∏ (e^(-λ) λ^(xᵢ) / xᵢ!) -> ln L(λ) = -nλ + (Σxᵢ) ln λ - Σ ln(xᵢ!) [2]. Differentiate: d(ln L)/dλ = -n + (Σxᵢ)/λ = 0 -> λ̂ = (Σxᵢ)/n = x̄ [2].

q:
ANOVA Concepts / Comparing >2 Means:
Explain why performing multiple separate pairwise t-tests across 5 treatments inflates family-wise Type I error, and how One-Way ANOVA solves this using Within-Group vs Between-Group variance (F-ratio). [4 marks]
a: 10 pairwise tests at α=0.05 inflate overall false-positive risk to ~40% [2]. ANOVA tests H₀: μ₁=...=μ₅ in one step via F = MS_Between / MS_Within [2].

q:
Queueing / Poisson-Exponential Link:
Customers arrive at a bank teller as a Poisson process with mean 12 per hour. What distribution models inter-arrival waiting times T (in minutes), and what is P(T > 10 minutes)? [4 marks]
a: Rate λ = 12/60 = 0.2 per minute; inter-arrival times follow Exponential Exp(0.2) [2]. P(T > 10) = e^(-0.2 × 10) = e⁻² = 0.1353 [2].

q:
Quality Control Charts:
On an x̄ statistical process control chart (target μ = 500 g, σ = 12 g, sample size n = 9), calculate the 3σ upper and lower Action Limits and 2σ Warning Limits. [4 marks]
a: SE = 12/√9 = 4.0 g. Warning limits = 500 ± 2(4) = 492 g and 508 g [2]. Action limits = 500 ± 3(4) = 488 g and 512 g [2].

q:
Covariance & Correlation of Transformed Variables:
Given r(X, Y) = 0.80, explain the exact effect on r if U = 3X + 10 and V = -2Y + 5. [3 marks]
a: Linear scaling preserves magnitude of correlation, while negative multiplier (-2) flips the sign: r(U, V) = -0.80 [3].

q:
P-Value Interpretation:
A researcher obtains p-value = 0.031 for a one-tailed test. State the conclusion at (a) α = 5% and (b) α = 1%, and warn against interpreting p = 0.031 as "probability H₀ is true". [4 marks]
a: (a) 0.031 < 0.05 -> reject H₀. (b) 0.031 > 0.01 -> fail to reject H₀ [2]. P-value is P(data this extreme OR more | H₀ true), NOT the probability that H₀ is true [2].
